name: rainbow_oak
comment: rainbow forest carrier - the actual placement uses the vanilla minecraft:oak / fancy_oak configured features via the feature-trees placement in config.yml (dense, water-safe, forest-tier density). ONLY oak-type features are used because oak leaves are biome-tinted: each rainbow_forest_NN biome's foliage tint recolors the oak canopy to its hue, producing the rainbow gradient. Birch/spruce leaves are NOT biome-tinted (fixed colors), so they are deliberately excluded - they would not turn rainbow. This baked definition is only the jigsaw carrier and a fallback shape.
